name: olikrys
description: Galerie d'art virtuelle OliKrys — React + TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Prisma

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.db:setup: npm --prefix server run db:migrate -- --name init && npm --prefix server run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
